notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

routeError.title: We couldn't show this page
routeError.message: Something unexpected went wrong. You can go back to the home page or reload the page.

appError.title: Something went wrong
appError.message: The app ran into an unexpected error. Reload the page to continue.

login.title: Sign in
login.invitationRedeemed: Your password is set. Sign in to continue.
login.passwordReset: Your new password is set. Sign in to continue.

reauth.title: Confirm your password
reauth.description: For your security, enter your password again to continue.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this page
forbidden.message: Ask an administrator to check your permissions.

common.usernameHint: 3 to 64 characters: letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.intro: Invite a person with a one-time link. No email is sent.

form.title: New invitation
form.staffNote: For a staff role you'll be asked for your password.

invite.title: Set your password
invite.incomplete: This link is incomplete. Open the link you were given again.
invite.signedIn: You're signed in as {{name}}. This link is for the person who was invited. Sign out, then open the link again.

oneTimeLink.onceWarning: This link is shown only once. Give it to the person in person or over the phone. It expires in 24 hours.
oneTimeLink.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. The link is selected: copy it by hand.

passwordResets.title: Password resets
passwordResets.intro: Create a one-time link so a person can set a new password. No email is sent.

form.title: New reset link
form.help: We'll ask for your password. The person's sessions end when they set the new password.
form.notAllowed: You can't issue a reset for this account. Only an Owner can reset Owner and Administrator accounts.
form.self: To change your own password, use Change password.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.signedIn: You're signed in as {{name}}. This link is for resetting another account's password. Sign out, then open the link again.

password.title: Change password
password.done: Your password was changed. You were signed out on your other devices.

register.title: Request an account
register.intro: The center will confirm your identity before the account works. Requesting an account doesn't enroll anyone in classes.
register.sent: Request sent. The center will confirm your identity. You can sign in with {{username}} once it is approved.

registrations.title: Account requests
registrations.intro: Confirm each person's identity outside the app before you approve. Approving a request never enrolls anyone.
registrations.approveConfirm: Confirm that you have verified the identity of {{name}} ({{role}}).
registrations.rejectConfirm: The username {{username}} can't be used again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.contactHelp: For contact only. Never used to sign in.
profile.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com, or leave it empty.
profile.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number with 7 to 32 digits, spaces or ( ) . - characters, or leave it empty.

status.title: Account status
status.suspendConfirm: Suspend {{name}}? All their sessions end and they can't sign in until you reactivate them. We'll ask for your password.
status.archiveConfirm: Archive {{name}}? Their sessions end and they can't sign in. Their history is kept and you can reactivate them later. We'll ask for your password.
status.archiveInvitationConfirm: Cancel {{name}}'s invitation? The link stops working. We'll ask for your password.
status.reactivateConfirm: Reactivate {{name}}? They can sign in again.
status.suspended: The account is suspended. Their sessions have ended.
status.reactivated: They can sign in with their existing password.
status.reactivatedNoPassword: This person has no password yet. Issue a password reset link.

reset.title: Password
reset.intro: We'll ask for your password. The person's sessions end when they set the new password.
